title: fix(metadata-core): an exclusive protocol comparator ('>18', '<18') names the major it admits in the refusal
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XCr4VkQzTohFoSHcnQxd1WY)_

Fixes #26546

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：包的 `engines.protocol` 用排他比较符时，`OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE` 拒绝里的目标主版本按比较方向读。在 18 的运行时上，`'>18'` 现在算“包比运行时新”，提示升级运行时到 19，不再给 `migrate meta`；`'<18'` 现在提示 `migrate meta --from 17`，不再是 `--from 18`。
- **为什么改**：原来把 `>`、`<` 当成 `^` 剥掉，两种写法都得到 `--from 18`，也就是“从运行时自己的主版本迁移”，运维照做没有用。
- **风险与回滚**：低。哪些范围被接受、哪些被拒绝完全不变（新旧读法在 17.8 万组范围与主版本组合上对照，准入结论零差异）；只改被拒绝时的目标主版本和提示。附带两处 CLI 读者跟着变对：`objectstack migrate meta` 迁到 18 时会把 `'<18'` 改写成 `'^18'`（与 `'<=17'` 一致），版本差提示也会为它出声。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-core/src/protocol-handshake.ts`（`alternativeMajorSpan`、`comparatorMajorSpan`、`declaredTargetMajor`）；`packages/metadata-core/src/protocol-handshake.test.ts` 末尾的 `[#26546]` 用例。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core exec vitest run src/protocol-handshake.test.ts`，预期 46/46 通过，其中 `[#26546]` 九条。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`checkProtocolCompat` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`) names a refused range's target major (`diagnostic.targetMajor`, also `error.details.targetMajor` on both install doors) and, for a package behind the runtime, `objectstack migrate meta --from N`. `declaredFloorMajor` found that major by peeling every leading `^ ~ < > =` and reading the first number, so a comparator's direction was lost.

The single-range grammar is now read once, as a span of admitted majors:

- `comparatorMajorSpan` (was `comparatorAdmitsMajor`) returns the interval one comparator admits (examples with 18): `'>=18'` is 18 and up, bare `'>18'` is 19 and up, `'>18.0.0'` is 18 and up, `'<=18'` is 18 and below, `'<18'` / `'<18.0.0'` is 17 and below, `'<18.5'` is 18 and below. These are exactly the cases the old `switch` encoded.
- `alternativeMajorSpan` (was the body of `alternativeAdmitsMajor`) returns one `||` alternative's span: compound ranges intersect their comparators, hyphen ranges are `[lo, hi]`, `^`, `~`, wildcard and exact pin one major, `*` is open both ways.
- `alternativeAdmitsMajor` asks whether the span holds the runtime major. `rangeAdmitsMajor` is unchanged.
- `declaredTargetMajor` (was `declaredFloorMajor`) reads the same span: its floor, or for a range open below, its ceiling. A `||` union still takes its lowest alternative. A span that holds no major (`'>=19 <15'`, `'<0'`) names none (`targetMajor: null`, bare `objectstack migrate meta`).

`checkProtocolCompat`'s ahead/behind split from #26530 is untouched; it now receives the right major. Answers on an 18 runtime:

| Range | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `'>18'` | 18 · `--from 18` | 19 · no `migrateCommand`, "Upgrade the runtime to protocol 19" |
| `'<18'`, `'<18.0.0'`, `'<18.0'` | 18 · `--from 18` | 17 · `--from 17` |
| `'<18 >=15'` | 18 · `--from 18` | 15 · `--from 15` |
| `'>15 <18'` | 15 · `--from 15` | 16 · `--from 16` |
| `'<17 \|\| >19'` | 17 · `--from 17` | 16 · `--from 16` |
| `'>18 \|\| ^20'` | 18 · `--from 18` | 19 · no `migrateCommand` |
| `'>=19 <15'` (admits nothing) | 19 · no `migrateCommand` | null · `objectstack migrate meta` |
| `'>=19'`, `'<=17'`, `'^17'`, `'~17.2'`, `'17.x'`, `'17'`, `'15 - 17'`, `'>=15 <18'`, `'^17 \|\| ^16'` | unchanged | unchanged |

On a 17 runtime `'>18'` used to say "Upgrade the runtime to protocol 18", which `'>18'` does not admit; it now says 19. Partial bounds keep their major: `'<18.5'` on 19 targets 18 and `'>18.1'` on 17 targets 18, as before.

The comments on `ProtocolIncompatibleDiagnostic.targetMajor` and `.migrateCommand` now describe the span reading. Changeset: `@objectstack/metadata-core` patch.

## Why

Card #26546, ruled by triage `6436651479`: on an 18 runtime, `'>18'` (the package is ahead) and `'<18'` (the package is behind) were both refused with `migrate meta --from 18`, which cannot apply in either case. Reading the target from the same span the admit verdict uses means the verdict and the prescription cannot read one comparator two ways.

## Tests

Red first on `main` at `7dd5a2ffa` (#26530 merged), the new `[#26546]` block in `protocol-handshake.test.ts`: **7 failed, 38 passed (45)**. The two inclusive controls (`'>=19'`, `'<=17'`) passed on `main`, as the ruling expects. The failures were `expected 18 to be 19` (`'>18'`), `expected 18 to be 17` (`'<18'`), `expected 18 to be 15` (`'<18 >=15'`), `expected 17 to be 16` (union), and the `'>18'` HTTP answer carrying `migrateCommand`. After the fix: **46/46** (one more case added after the red run: a range that admits no major names none).

Ablation (fix committed, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): `const major = empty ? null : (span.lo ?? span.hi);` in `declaredTargetMajor` replaced by the old peel, `leadingMajor(alternative.replace(/^[\^~<>=\s]+/, ''))`. Anchor 1 → 0, blob `d918d6077d87` → `10fd32563699`; **8 failed, 38 passed**, every control green. Restored by the tool; `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards.

Admit verdicts do not move: a one-off differential (scratch script, not committed) loaded the `main` copy and this copy of `protocol-handshake.ts` side by side and compared `rangeAdmitsMajor` and `checkProtocolCompat(...).status` over 8,103 ranges (every operator × 15 version tokens, comma and space compounds of every comparator pair, and `||` unions) on runtime majors 0 to 21: **178,266 cases, 0 differences**.

Whole package and dependents:

- `@objectstack/metadata-core`: `pnpm test` 836/836 (20 files); `pnpm typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` and `-p tsconfig.test.json`) exit 0.
- `@objectstack/cli` (unit): `src/utils/protocol-version-gap.test.ts` and `test/migrate-meta-protocol-range.test.ts`, 35/35.
- `@objectstack/runtime`: `src/domains/packages-install-protocol-incompatible.test.ts` and `src/app-plugin.test.ts`, 44/44.
- `@objectstack/cloud-connection`: `src/marketplace-install-local-protocol-handshake.test.ts`, 13/13.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the two touched `.ts` files: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Two CLI readers of `targetMajor` change answer for `'<18'`-style ranges, measured** (throwaway probe in `packages/cli`, not committed; cli's vitest aliases metadata-core to `src`). `planProtocolRange` (`objectstack migrate meta`) used to leave `'<18'` alone when migrating to 18 (target 18 is not below 18, by code reading at `main`); it now rewrites it to `'^18'` from `--from 17`, and with `--from 18` reports `behind-from` naming 17, the same answers it gives `'<=17'` and `'^17'`. `checkProtocolVersionGap` used to stay silent for `'<18'` on an 18 install and now says it "targets protocol v17". `'>18'` stays silent in both. The runtime's artifact boot refusal (`artifact-reference.ts`) names `targetMajor` in its "run a runtime image for protocol N" line, which now reads 19 for `'>18'`. None of these readers' tests moved.
- **Declarations.** `Clause-②: no`: no range moves between admitted and refused (the differential above), no exported type changes, and `migrateCommand` was already optional after #26530. `targetMajor` changes value only on refusals, and for the cases where it was wrong; the changeset names every changed reading. `Metadata-protocol: none`: no spec key, schema or stored shape is involved.
- **Spec comment, not this lane.** The `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE` row comment in `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` lists `migrateCommand` among `error.details` members; it is absent in the ahead case since #26530, and `'>N'` on an N runtime now reaches that case. ADR-0087 D1 describes the refusal carrying "the exact replay command". Both are under the spec seat and are left as they are.
- **No open PR touches `protocol-handshake.ts`**: checked the files of all 23 open PRs before opening this one.
